<thought>Based on the observed isotopic peak series spaced ~1.003 Da apart and the relative intensities (M+1 ≈ 14 % of M, M+2 ≈ 1 % of M), the pattern matches the natural 13C distribution for a molecule containing ~13 carbons. No characteristic M+2 ≈ 30‑50 % pattern of Cl or Br is present, and the M+2 intensity is far lower than expected for sulfur. Thus only carbon can be definitively identified from the isotope distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
